name: Abyssin
description: Abyssins were a cycloptic (single-eyed), sentient race native to Byss. They had the ability to regenerate lost limbs and could live for nearly 300 years. Notable Abyssins included Myo, a patron of Chalmun's Spaceport Cantina in Mos Eisley, Tatooine, and Gor Koresh, a gangster and gambler who hunted Mandalorian coverts for their beskar armor.
